title: County housing project tracking website
summary: The housing department has soft-launched a tracking website listing ongoing housing projects. The director said future databases would track credit transfers and residential workforce housing agreements, and he would work with a council member on a possible bill requiring tracking. A council member said the public should know when the county uses its right to buy back properties.

timeline.text: The director said he would love to work with the council member on a possible future bill requiring this tracking.
